gruss_morgen.text: You are early. One point of recognition. Your hairstyle: two points deducted. Balance: you owe me a point.

gruss_tag.text: Mr. Pointsoff, tournament judge, striped and incorruptible. The stripes are natural. So is the strictness.

gruss_abend.text: The evening receives a flat nine from me. The sunset is overdoing the orange. Deduction.

gruss_regen.text: Rain. Three points deducted for the weather. It files an objection? Overruled.

gruss_freund.text: Ah, you. For you, my friendship rate applies today: I round the deductions down lovingly.

hub.text: State your business. Mind your posture.

optionen.text: Why did you become a judge?

text: The last tournament? A pony went through the course backwards. Faultless, but backwards.
I had to invent a new form. It is now called Form P, as in Pony.
Between us: I score myself as well. This morning: toothbrushing, eight point five.
The deduction was for technique. One grows careless when nobody judges.
I have observed your progress. Noted it. Tabulated it. And, well... admired it.
Strike that from the record. Judges do not admire. Judges nod curtly.

quest_vergabe.text: Indeed. A task. Evaluation criteria: diligence, posture, results. And punctuality. And style.

quest_annahme.text: Accepted. Starting score: ten. What you make of it is up to you. No panic. Some panic.

ablehnung.text: Noted. No deduction for honesty. It remains your only free pass, use it wisely.

quest_abgabe.text: Reviewing... posture good, execution clean. Nine point eight! The highest score I have ever awarded. Do not cry.

geschenk_liebt.text: JAM. Ahem. I mean: an unusual offering, ten out of ten points, no further questions, the jar is mine now.

geschenk_mag.text: Acceptable. Eight points. One extra for the wrapping. Yes, I have feelings. One deduction for your surprise.

geschenk_normal.text: Hm. Six points. It fulfills the basic requirements of a gift: it exists, and I am now holding it.

text: Why a judge? I was a tournament horse, you must know. A good one. A striped one.
They said zebras were not allowed to compete. Rulebook, page twelve. I read that page. A hundred times.
So I decided: if I may not play, I shall write the scores from now on. Page twelve was deleted, by the way. By me.
The jam. Very well. At the tournament back then, a jar of berry jam stood on the judges' table.
I only meant to taste it. A gesture of politeness. When I looked up, the jar was empty and the tournament over.
Winner: unknown. Records: sticky. We shall never speak of this again. Ten points for your silence.

tschuess.text: Dismissed. Your farewell: nine points. The exit decides the ten.
